title: Switzerland: ISO practice (SN EN ISO), German labels, decimal comma

rules.language: Drawing texts in Swiss Standard German (no sharp s: 'Massstab'). Title block labels: Benennung, Zeichnungsnummer, Werkstoff, Massstab, Blatt, Index, Allgemeintoleranz, Gezeichnet, Geprüft, Datum.
rules.decimal: Decimal comma in dimensions and notes (12,5); dates as DD.MM.YYYY in the title block.
rules.title_block: Title block per ISO 7200 at the bottom right, filled: Benennung, Zeichnungsnummer, Index, Werkstoff, Massstab, Blatt n/N, projection symbol method 1, 'ISO 2768-mK', 'Gezeichnet: NXonaut', date of first issue.
rules.standards_prefix: Cite standards as SN EN ISO where adopted (e.g. 'ISO 2768-mK' is fine in the title block).
